The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Furen Makers from China
Furen Makers developed a brainwave-controlled wheelchair to help people with ALS and physical disabilities support mobility and independence.

By translating neural signals into motion, this innovation allows users to move without relying on hand control.

Furen Makers demonstrates how technology can help support dignity and opportunity.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution moves minds and bodies forward.
